summary: Full backend (19 pytest incl. socket.io E2E flow) + frontend UI testing of Crypto Conex. All requested API and socket flows pass. CRM admin & technician UI flows (login, queue, assign select, assign-to-me, open session, all command buttons, message/type, logs, a11y tab, logout) work and commands reach the simulated device. Public page: CONECTAR, download, voice, +/- buttons clickable; with a mocked getDisplayMedia (canvas stream) the device registered, showed PIN, CRM received LIVE WebRTC video (videoWidth=320, badge 'AO VIVO'), guided message reached public page as toast, and device disconnect set CRM badge to 'encerrada'. Main defect: font +/- accessibility control does not enlarge most text.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout (6+ wrong attempts all return 401, never locked). No httpOnly auth cookie (token stored in localStorage, Bearer only).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True (responds access-control-allow-origin: * + allow-credentials: true). Use explicit origins.

No session authorization: any authenticated operator (incl. technician) can operator:subscribe / command:send to ANY session_id; unauthenticated clients can emit rtc:offer/rtc:ice/a11y:tree/a11y:request into any session room without being a member. Validate that the sid belongs to the session room / is assigned technician or admin.
TURN credentials hardcoded in ICE_SERVERS; ADMIN_PASSWORD has fallback default 'admin123' (should fail fast from env).
Session becomes 'active' (shown 'AO VIVO' in queue) as soon as operator subscribes even if no stream; never reverts when operator leaves/disconnects.

ui_bugs.issue: font-increase/decrease only sets inline fontSize on the root div (16px->20.8px) but all text uses Tailwind rem-based classes (text-xl, text-4xl, etc.), so h1 stays 36px and most visible text does not grow. Scale document.documentElement.style.fontSize instead, or use em units.
FILA/ATIVAS/ONLINE stats only refresh via refresh() (mount/refresh button/assigned-to-you) and not on socket 'queue:update', so they go stale (e.g. showed FILA 1 ATIVAS 0 while session was AO VIVO).

integration_issues.issue: Both sock.on('connect') and sock.io.on('reconnect') emit device:register; 'connect' also fires on reconnect, so a reconnect creates TWO new sessions; old RTCPeerConnection is not closed before buildPeer in device:registered (leak).

integration_issues.flow: Operator switching/re-opening session or 2 operators on same session
integration_issues.issue: Device reuses one RTCPeerConnection and re-offers on each operator:joined; rtc:offer is broadcast to ALL operators in the room, so admin+tech both answer -> device gets second answer in 'stable' state (InvalidStateError, unhandled). Re-opening a session after switching creates a new operator PC against an already-negotiated device PC -> video may not recover. Consider one PC per operator (keyed by operator sid) and target signaling to a specific sid.

issues: Admin assign select still shows on already-assigned sessions with label reset ('Atribuir a…' shown next to assigned tech) - minor
Queue shows multiple identical 'TEST_UI_Device' names; consider showing PIN in queue item to distinguish sessions
Sonner toast at top-right overlaps header stats/logout briefly

action_items: Fix public page font scaling (scale html root font-size) - core accessibility requirement for elderly users
Update header stats on queue:update (call refresh or compute from sessions)
Remove duplicate device:register on reconnect (keep only 'connect' handler) and close old PC before rebuilding
Make WebRTC signaling per-operator (target sid) to support re-open/multiple viewers; handle setRemoteDescription errors
Add socket-level authorization for session events (operator must be admin or assigned tech; device must own session)
Add brute-force lockout on login, explicit CORS origins, move TURN creds + admin password to env with no default
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: no ownership checks on operator:subscribe/command:send/rtc:*/a11y:* events
server.py: queue:update broadcasts all sessions to every operator including technicians (they see other techs' sessions)
PublicConnect.jsx: rtc:answer/rtc:ice handlers lack try/catch; pcRef can be null after cleanup
Dashboard.jsx: refresh() swallows errors silently (no error state); expired token produces empty dashboard rather than redirect

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `-n 0` (pytest.ini enables xdist; tests depend on order: tech must be registered first). device_sim.py <seconds> registers a fake android device in background for UI tests. To test real WebRTC in headless, monkeypatch navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia to return canvas.captureStream() before clicking CONECTAR - this produced live video in CRM.
rca of the issue: Font scaling: fontScale applied as inline style fontSize on a div, but Tailwind text-* utilities use rem (relative to <html>), so child text ignores the change.
